resolution.note: ship completes the pending close row (pr, ci) after merge; verified by close-evidence and ship tests with a verbatim gh capture

title: Ship completes the close evidence row with the merged PR and Check conclusion
body:
Outcome: the exposure evidence row of a lane-closed task carries the merged PR number and the Check conclusion. Today (#1134) `krn task close --as done` reads `gh pr view` for the current branch, but a lane closes its task inside its worktree before `krn pr ship` opens the PR, so pr and ci are null on the normal path; `krn pr ship` should write (or complete) the evidence row after the merge it records.
Why: S19 lane report 2026-11-16; without this, S19's evidence is empty for every lane-delivered task and exposures cannot learn from outcomes.
Proof: a test drives close-in-worktree then a ship merge record (verbatim gh capture) and finds an exposure row with pr and ci set.
